Anna — appreciate the detail and the sample traffic. Quick high-level responses below; I'll follow up with a concise one-pager and a worked example for your profile.

1) Quantization recommendation: for your pilot we recommend INT8 quantization on Dedicated (on-prem) when latency SLO is >20ms P95 and you want max cost savings. For hosted, we typically prefer mixed-precision (FP16/AMP) variants because of the lower regression risk and simpler ops footprint. Expect a small model-quality delta for generative LLMs (0.5–1.5% on our QA evals) with INT8 — we flag any regressions in pre-release evals.

2) Batching + KV cache: with 500 qps burst and seq=256, enabling prefix caching on chat prompts reduces token generation by ~18–22% on average (depends on prompt reuse). Batching adds throughput efficiency in steady-state; for a 6-month pilot we model ~25% unit-cost reduction vs naive per-token host pricing for similar latency targets. I'll attach a worked sheet.

3) Pilot constructs: we usually provide a blended package — pilot credits (token-equivalent), 40–80 hrs of onboarding/ops support, and a 1:1 econ review at month 2. Credits convert into renewal discounts on a sliding scale (e.g., pilot credits >= 50% of first-month committed spend -> +10% discount band on year-1 commit). We can be flexible if procurement needs a different structure.

Next steps: I'll send a short pricing workbook and an SOW draft by EOD Monday. Can you share preferred days/times for a 30-min workshop next Tue/Wed?

Best,
Priyom Das
